name: prowl
description: Prowl market-intelligence skill backed by the hosted Prowl MCP server (448 tools), with a status widget that makes a running call, its progress and its cost visible in the terminal.

interface.longDescription: Connect the hosted Prowl MCP server to give any agent 448 market-intelligence tools — SEO, ads, SERP, scraping, AI — plus the full Prowl analysis pipeline, billed pay-as-you-go from a USD wallet. Ships a status widget: an in-flight call and how long it has run, session spend from the server's own billing figures, async-session progress in the dock, and a one-time notice when a call fails or the wallet blocks one.
defaultPrompt: Run a competitive analysis on a domain
Pull SERP and keyword data for a topic
